title: Software Engineer 2
highlights: Built a deployment orchestration dashboard on a shared GitHub Actions framework, automating branch cuts, merges and one-click deploys with health checks from Grafana, Argo CD and Jenkins in one place. Releases went from 5–6 hours to under 2.
Replaced a GitHub-based document workflow, where every change needed a developer, with a SaaS knowledge-base editor with versioning, checkpoints and rollback. Updates now take about 10 minutes.

Migrated distributed services from ECS to EKS to address rising costs and scaling limits, with a zero-downtime cutover across environments and a clear path to multi-region, active-active disaster recovery.
Fixed Kafka consumers that weren't shutting down cleanly and kept triggering consumer-group rebalances, improving reliability for a system handling about 2.5M requests a day.

Replaced a fixed three-tier permission model with role-based access control across multi-tenant accounts, and built a pipeline that masks PII from partner webhook events and produces daily compliance reports.

Added Twilio and Shopify integrations, voice calling for customer chatbots with Amazon Connect, AI-driven observability with HUD.io, and a GitHub Action that uses Claude to fix Dependabot alerts automatically.

title: Graduate Assistant (Software Development)
highlights: Built an end-to-end analytics dashboard on the MEVN stack, processing 30,000+ applicant records each semester for the enrollment teams.
Integrated the university's single sign-on (SAML and CAS 3.0 with two-factor authentication) for secure, role-based access.
Traced slow page loads to repeated queries for filter data and cached it in Redis, cutting response times from seconds to milliseconds.
Standardized 60,000+ free-text addresses with a geolocation API, improving search and filter accuracy by 18%.

title: Data Engineer
highlights: Built distributed ETL pipelines with Apache Spark and SparkSQL for financial crime detection, processing 20–30M+ records per job into partitioned Parquet.
Orchestrated 50+ interdependent daily and hourly jobs as a DAG with Autosys and Scala, reliably exporting 50M+ records a day for financial crime alerts.
Fixed a bottleneck caused by data skew with repartitioning and caching, cutting job runtime by up to 50% to consistently meet a 60-minute SLA.
Added load-assurance checks to 60+ jobs, cross-validating record counts against ingestion metadata, which improved data reliability and cut debugging time.
